title: Control and Power Systems for the Columbia University Tokamak for Education (CUTE)
abstract: Designing, wiring, and testing power, control, and safety systems 20+ hours/week for the Tokamak for Education. Conducted low voltage testing on capacitor bank setups and safety circuits; wired high voltage power supply and capacitor banks; tested control system modifications and established network connection with the oscilloscope.

title: Hall Probe Magnetic Field Sensor and Interlocked Winding System for the Columbia Stellarator eXperiment
abstract: Developed an interlocked winding system for full-scale interlocked coils and a Hall probe-based magnetic field sensor for the CSX Stellarator. Collaborated in assembly of the vacuum chamber setup, CAD modeling, and machining.

title: Drone Journalist
abstract: Worked on a vision system for a journalist drone, assisted with voice processing debugging, and full hardware assembly. Stack: Raspberry Pi, Linux, Bash, Python, AI.

title: Memory Game
abstract: Arduino-based memory game with button-screen-speaker IO interface. Used 3D printing and laser cutting for manufacturing with Visual Studio and Arduino IDE.

title: Guitar Learning App
abstract: Full-stack Android application serving a REST API with Kotlin frontend. Processed sound and images using FFTs and OpenCV for Optical Music Recognition. Created multi-table local (ROOM) and global (MySQL) databases with Node.js backend.

title: FIRST Robotics Team 8504 — Rookie Game Changer Award
abstract: Spearheaded the team in winning the Rookie Game Changer Award among 10,000+ international squads. Developed the robot's transmission system and assembled the primary CAD model with 650+ parts.
